title: Supported Mersenne achievement sets: topology, coordinate splitting, and exact volume dichotomy

concepts.label: supported Mersenne achievement set
concepts.note: Values coded by binary Mersenne digits constrained to a prescribed support J.

concepts.label: supported-set topology
concepts.note: Compactness, nowhere density, and perfectness for infinite support.

concepts.label: one-coordinate face split
concepts.note: The disjoint translate decomposition obtained by allowing one new digit.

concepts.label: exact volume dichotomy
concepts.note: Positive dyadic measure for finite codimension and zero measure for infinite codimension.

routing_bases.supported_topology_domain_model: The supported digit set and its closedness identify the compact source space whose continuous image is the restricted achievement set; these declarations are contextual representation and engine substrate, not separate topology conclusions.
routing_bases.supported_topology_image_bridge: The exact image equality converts the subtype-range definition into the full digit-map image used by the compactness and preperfectness arguments.
routing_bases.supported_nowhere_density_inheritance: The exact inclusion in the full Mersenne achievement set is the hereditary step used to transfer nowhere density to every supported set.
routing_bases.supported_perfectness_assembly: Closedness and transferred preperfectness are precisely the two components assembled into the perfectness theorem at line 167.
routing_bases.coordinate_update_split_engine: The exact one-coordinate update identity is the representation engine behind the disjoint two-face split and its measure consequence.
routing_bases.full_support_volume_anchor: The unrestricted supported set is identified with the full measure-one achievement set, supplying the finite-codimension induction base.
routing_bases.finite_codimension_volume_induction: The division-free finite-complement identity is the induction engine from repeated one-coordinate doubling to the exact dyadic volume formula.
routing_bases.infinite_codimension_monotone_trap: Support monotonicity traps an infinite-complement supported set below finite-codimension faces of arbitrarily small volume.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED TOPOLOGICAL GEOMETRY: supportedMersenneAchievementSet J is the range of Mersenne digit values supported on J; for every support J it is compact and nowhere dense.
statement_nodes.engine: Continuous image of the closed supported digit subspace for compactness, followed by inclusion in the full nowhere-dense Mersenne achievement set.
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Lean-checked topology of the project-specific reciprocal-Mersenne achievement sets; no external novelty claim is made.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: Compactness and nowhere density classify the set geometrically. They decide neither membership of 1/2 nor irrationality of any individual supported subseries.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED INFINITE-SUPPORT GEOMETRY: if J is infinite, then the supported digit subspace has no isolated points, and the supported Mersenne achievement set is perfect.
statement_nodes.engine: Flip an unrestricted coordinate outside each finite basic neighbourhood, then transfer preperfectness through the continuous injective digit map and combine it with closedness.
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: A formal Cantor-space no-isolated-point argument specialised to supported Mersenne digit values.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The theorem is an implication from infinitude of J; these selected declarations do not prove the converse. Perfectness still makes no arithmetic classification of individual points.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED ONE-COORDINATE SELF-SIMILARITY: if k is not in J, the zero face supported on J and its translate by mersenneWeight (k+1) are disjoint; consequently allowing k doubles the Lebesgue measure of the supported achievement set.
statement_nodes.engine: Unique Mersenne digit coding separates the two faces; translation invariance and additivity of Lebesgue measure turn the exact split into the doubling law.
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Project-specific formalisation of a standard binary-face decomposition.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The result compares measures after adding one allowed coordinate. It does not assert that an arbitrary supported set has positive measure.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED COMPLETE VOLUME CLASSIFICATION: for every J, either J is the complement of a finite set F and the supported achievement set has volume (2^|F|)^-1, or J has infinite complement and the supported achievement set has volume zero.
statement_nodes.engine: Finite-coordinate doubling from the full measure-one set, plus monotonic trapping below finite-codimension faces of arbitrarily small dyadic measure when the complement is infinite.
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Exact Lean-checked measure classification for the supported reciprocal-Mersenne achievement sets; no priority claim is made.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: Measure classifies the size of each value set, not the arithmetic nature of its points. The dichotomy does not settle Erdős #257.

intra_zone_relations.basis: For infinite J, the no-isolated-point argument supplements the compact closed geometry with perfectness; nowhere density remains valid for every J.
The face split uses compact measurability and injective coding but adds an exact metric self-similarity statement.
The finite-codimension branch iterates the one-coordinate doubling law; the infinite-codimension branch is obtained by monotone comparison with those finite faces.
